SIGNATURE NEST GIFTS LLC

Privacy Policy

Effective November 11, 2026

This page explains how Signature Nest Gifts LLC handles information provided through this website and service enquiries.

Information you choose to share

When you contact us, you may provide your name, email address, shop link and information about the services you need. Please do not include account passwords, payment card information or unnecessary buyer information in an enquiry.

How the enquiry form works

The enquiry form prepares an email using the information you enter. It opens your email application, where you can review and send the message. The website itself does not send or save form submissions. The copy function places your request on your clipboard when you choose it. Your email provider handles any email you send under its own terms.

How we use enquiries

Information received by email is used to respond to your request, discuss a quote and arrange services. Where a service agreement is signed, the agreement describes the relevant confidentiality and data-handling responsibilities.

Website services

Our hosting provider may process technical information such as IP address and request logs to deliver and secure the website. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives connection information when those files are requested. This website does not include advertising trackers or analytics scripts, and the enquiry form does not use browser storage.

Retention and requests

Enquiry and service records are retained for business purposes and applicable recordkeeping requirements. To ask about your information or request a correction or deletion, contact us using the details below. Requests are reviewed in light of any contractual or recordkeeping obligations.
